signals.title: MADLANGA COMMISSION: ‘My son was murdered in cold blood by the police,’ father tells inquiry
signals.summary: Gregory Loftus, the father of a tow truck operator who was killed in a shooting in Durban in 2023, has told the Madlanga Commission that the day before this happened, he tried to interdict police officers from murdering his son. Other evidence, meanwhile, suggested his son was a “notorious” figure.

signals.title: Survivors tell of horror of Zimbabwe ferry sinking as death toll hits 46
signals.summary:
A man who survived a ferry disaster that claimed at least 46 lives on Zimbabwe’s Lake Kariba told AFP Thursday how he watched helplessly as people tried to save themselves, with his best friend and seven of his relatives among the dead. The overloaded government ferry — a vital link for villagers and fish traders…
Source

signals.title: Lac Kariba : le Zimbabwe rend hommage aux victimes du naufrage d’un ferry
signals.summary: Le lac Kariba a continué jeudi de livrer les corps d’un naufrage qui a déjà décimé plusieurs familles et plongé des villages entiers dans le deuil. Deux jours après le chavirement du ferry gouvernemental, la police zimbabwéenne a porté à 46 le nombre de morts.

signals.title: Zimbabwe's Kariba ferry disaster victims honoured as death toll reaches 44
signals.summary: Hundreds gathered for a memorial service in northern Zimbabwe on Thursday to honour victims of the Lake Kariba ferry disaster, which killed at least 44 people. Survivors recalled a desperate struggle for life as the vessel capsized in rough waters.

signals.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to a sixth province
signals.summary: Ebola outbreak has killed 2,128 people out of around 4,566 recorded cases in the DRC, according to government figures.

signals.title: Mozambique: State revenue exceeds 183 billion meticais in first half of 2026
signals.summary:
The Mozambican Government collected about 183.27690 billion meticais in revenue during the first half of 2026, equivalent to 45% of the target set in the Economic and Social Plan. The information was provided on Tuesday by spokesperson for the 24th session of the Council of Ministers, Inocêncio Impissa, during the usual briefing following the meeting.…
Source

signals.title: Côte d'Ivoire: au moins sept morts dans des violences intercommunautaires liées à un différend foncier
signals.summary: La justice ivoirienne vient d'inculper 18 suspects dans une affaire de violences intercommunautaires. Survenus la semaine dernière à Kossandji, à une soixantaine de kilomètres d’Abidjan, les affrontements ont fait au moins sept morts. Une personne est également toujours portée disparue. Une information judiciaire a été ouverte.

signals.title: Ramaphosa Mourns 44 Killed in Lake Kariba Disaster
signals.summary: [Scrolla] · At least 44 people died after a ferry carrying passengers on Lake Kariba overturned after hitting strong waves on Tuesday.

signals.title: Super Falcons Coach Madugu Fires Back At Critics Ahead of South Africa World Cup Play-Off
signals.summary: [Premium Times] Justin Madugu has defended his team selection and tactical decisions, insisting Nigeria are focused on beating South Africa and keeping their 2027 World Cup hopes alive.

signals.title: South African Diplomat Issues Apology Over Recent Acts of Xenophobia
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- The newly designated South African High Commissioner to Mozambique, JT Pitswane, on Wednesday issued a formal apology to Mozambicans over recent acts of xenophobia in his territory, describing the attacks as contrary to the historic ties of friendship between the two nations.

signals.title: Nigeria : la santé, nouvelle bataille pour les otages de Woro après leur libération
signals.summary: Après avoir été secourus, 57 victimes d'enlèvement, dont des enfants, sont actuellement soignées à l'hôpital universitaire de l'État de Kwara.

signals.title: Nigeria's rescued kidnap victims face physical and psychological toll
signals.summary: Fifty-seven residents of Woro, rescued earlier this month, are being treated at a hospital in Ilorin, with most of the suffering notably from malnutrition.

signals.title: 149 Dead but No Police Convicted Over Task Team Shootings
signals.summary: [Scrolla] · Independent Police Investigative Directorate deputy Len John says 149 people died during 77 KwaZulu-Natal task team operations investigated by the police watchdog.

signals.title: Afrique du Sud: l’histoire méconnue des camps d'entraînement de l’ANC en Angola
signals.summary: L'Afrique du Sud lance une vaste opération de rapatriement des corps de militants anti-apartheid décédés en exil. Les équipes de recherche sud-africaines ont identifié 89 sépultures et près de 400 sites destinés à des fouilles. Selon Pretoria, c’est en Angola, alors en pleine guerre civile, qu’est mort le plus grand nombre de combattants de l’ANC pendant le régime de l'apartheid. Pourquoi se rendaient-ils en Angola ? Quels étaient leurs liens avec le MPLA, alors en guerre…

signals.title: #osundecides2026 - a Governorship Election Trailed By Sorrow, Tears, Blood
signals.summary: [Premium Times] No fewer than 73 election-related violent incidents leading to 29 deaths have been recorded in the build-up to the election, with Osogbo, the state capital, emerging as the worst-hit.

signals.title: Zimbabwe: un naufrage sur le lac Kariba fait plus de 40 morts
signals.summary: Au moins 44 personnes ont perdu la vie dans le naufrage d’un bateau survenu mardi 11 août sur le lac Kariba, à la frontière entre la Zambie et le Zimbabwe. 77 autres passagers ont été secourus selon la police. Le navire, appartenant à l’agence gouvernementale de développement rural, assurait la liaison entre les villes zimbabwéennes de Kariba et Chalala, avec des escales dans plusieurs îles et villages de pêcheurs. Le président zimbabwéen Emmerson Mnangagwa a décrété…

signals.title: Guinée: des centaines de personnes victimes d'arnaques aux cryptomonnaies
signals.summary: Ces épargnants ont déposé des sommes allant de quelques centaines à quelques milliers d'euros sur des plateformes de crypto-actifs, attirés par des taux d'intérêt alléchants et l'espoir d'empocher des gains rapides. Mais beaucoup perdent tout, car ils ne peuvent finalement plus retirer leur argent. Ce phénomène prend de l'ampleur depuis plusieurs mois à cause de promoteurs très actifs sur les réseaux sociaux, au point de pousser la Banque centrale à réagir.

signals.title: Kenya: les victimes d’abus du contingent britannique présentent leurs doléances
signals.summary: Au Kenya, la présence de soldats britanniques près de Nanyuki dans le centre du Kenya continue de faire débat. Londres y a un camp d’entraînement militaire, la BATUK. Plus de 1 000 soldats britanniques viennent chaque année y passer quelques semaines pour s’entraîner. Mais ces troupes ont été accusées à multiples reprises de violations de droits humains : blessures et décès à cause de munitions non explosées, viols et agressions sexuelles ou encore abandons d’enfants.…

signals.title: Ebola en RDC : le cap des 2000 morts franchi
signals.summary: En RDC, l’épidémie d’Ebola approche du bilan le plus meurtrier jamais enregistré dans le pays. Le virus a déjà fait 2 011 morts sur 4 381 cas confirmés, contre 2 300 décès lors de l’épidémie de 2018-2020. Les autorités congolaises estiment que le pic n’est pas encore atteint.

signals.title: Au Nigéria, le village d'Orimedu menacé par l'érosion côtière
signals.summary: À Orimedu, village de pêcheurs sur le littoral de l’État de Lagos, au Nigeria, l’érosion côtière et la montée des eaux gagnent du terrain. Des maisons sont endommagées et les activités de pêche menacées. Habitants et scientifiques expérimentent des réponses face à cette urgence.

signals.title: Taxi Driver or Potential Killer? Uganda's Deadly Culture of Reckless Driving
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Fourteen people died in Lwera. Two more died days later in Kakira. Now, 11 commuter taxi drivers have been arrested for allegedly engaging in dangerous loading during a night operation at Maya along the Kampala-Masaka Highway.

signals.title: Mortgage Approval Does Not Guarantee the Keys to Your Home, Absa Says
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Getting a mortgage approved does not necessarily mean a homebuyer is immediately ready to take possession of a property, with Absa Bank Kenya highlighting the legal and conveyancing steps that must be completed before financing can be disbursed.

signals.title: Afrique du Sud : 14 morts après un éboulement dans une mine près de Rustenburg
signals.summary: En Afrique du Sud, 14 mineurs sont morts après l’effondrement, lundi soir, d’un puits abandonné près de Rustenburg. Huit autres ont été grièvement blessés et plusieurs personnes seraient encore piégées sous terre.

signals.title: Court Orders Govt to Set Aside Millons for Torture, Abduction Victims
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The government has been ordered to set aside Sh105 million from a compensation fund for victims of torture, enforced disappearances and abductions as a court considers a legal challenge to a government verification process.

signals.title: Nigeria : libérés, des otages racontent leur calvaire de six mois en captivité
signals.summary: Les victimes ont été enlevées le 3 février 2026, lorsque des terroristes ont attaqué leur communauté.

signals.title: Rescued kidnap victims in Nigeria recount ordeal during 6 months of captivity
signals.summary: After six months in captivity, victims of a mass kipnapping in Nigeria’s Kwara state have been recounting their ordeal. More than 100 people abducted from the Woro community were rescued by government forces earlier this month.

signals.title: Zimbabwe : 15 morts dans le chavirement d'un bateau
signals.summary: ''Alors que nous étions dans l’eau, nous avons aperçu un signal de détresse, puis des bateaux qui se trouvaient à proximité sont intervenus'', témoin.

signals.title: At least 14 artisanal miners killed after illegal mine collapses
signals.summary: At least 14 artisanal miners were killed and eight others injured when the walls of an illegal mine collapsed in on them, South African police said on Tuesday.

signals.title: Afrique du Sud : 14 mineurs artisanaux tués dans l'effondrement d'une mine
signals.summary: La plupart des victimes semblaient être des ressortissants du Lesotho voisin, a indiqué la police.

signals.title: Morocco Expects Scorching Heat From Sunday to Tuesday
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- Scorching heat is expected from Sunday to Tuesday in several provinces of the Kingdom, according to the General Directorate of Meteorology (DGM) in an orange-level weather alert.

signals.title: « Saroukh », « El Hamra », « Madame Courage » : ces psychotropes qui menacent l’Algérie
signals.summary: Plus de 44 millions de comprimés saisis en 2025, 28 voyageurs tués fin juillet dans un accident causé par un chauffeur de bus drogué, des consommateurs jusque dans les cours d’école… L’Algérie s’émeut et s’inquiète de la prolifération des psychotropes, qui gangrènent et menacent toute la société.

signals.title: RDC : Ebola fait 2 011 morts, sur fond de probable transmission animale
signals.summary: Partie de l’Ituri, dans le nord-est du pays, l’épidémie s’étend à plusieurs provinces dans un contexte de conflits armés, et de défiance envers les autorités sanitaires. Une étude pointe une probable nouvelle transmission de l’animal à l’homme à l’origine du variant Bundibugyo.

signals.title: Africa Health Agencies Urge Faster Ebola Response in DRC As Cases Rise
signals.summary: [Independent (Kampala)] The Democratic Republic of Congo needs to urgently expand its community-led response to Ebola as new infections and deaths continue to outpace efforts to contain the outbreak, the World Health Organization and Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention said.

signals.title: Bié Provincial Data Registers Reduction On Road Accident Deaths
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Cuito -- A total of 75 people died as a result of 276 road accidents that occurred in the province of Bié during the 2026 first semester, which is fewer deaths compared to the previous period.

signals.title: Zanzibar Bolsters Community Health Workers' Capacity in Reducing Maternal, Child Deaths
signals.summary: [Daily News] Zanzibar -- THAMINI Uhai Organisation has held a meeting with senior officials from the Zanzibar Ministry of Health to bolster the capacity of leaders and healthcare providers in implementing interventions aimed at reducing maternal deaths during pregnancy and childbirth, as well as newborn deaths.

signals.title: Five Cabo Ledo Crash Victims in Critical Condition
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- Five of the 30 people injured in the road accident that occurred in Cabo Ledo, Icolo e Bengo Province, are in critical condition, some with fractures and lung contusions, Health Minister Sílvia Lutucuta said on Sunday in Luanda.

signals.title: Eight Dead Following Road Accident in Maputo and Manica
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- At least eight people died and 32 others were injured following two violent road accidents on Friday evening, according to Mozambican authorities.

signals.title: Four Victims of Cuanza-Sul Accident Already Identified
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Benguela -- Four of the 22 people killed in the accident involving a bus and a three-wheeled motorized vehicle, which occurred on Monday on National Road 100 in Cuanza-Sul province, have already been identified.

signals.title: Experts Collect Samples to Identify the Victims of the Accident in Cuanza-Sul
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Benguela -- Experts from the Department of Forensic Medicine began collecting biological samples on Thursday in Benguela from relatives of the victims of the road accident that occurred in Cuanza-Sul province, in order to identify the bodies, forensic pathologist Fátima de Almeida reported.

signals.title: Angola Criminalizes False Information On the Internet
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- Individuals who disseminate false information online in Angola will now face civil and criminal liability under the law governing this matter, which officially came into force on Tuesday.

signals.title: No Namibian in Angola Bus Crash
signals.summary: [Namibian] The Ministry of International Relations and Trade has confirmed that no Namibian national is currently reported killed or injured in Monday's deadly bus crash in Angola's Cuanza Sul province.

signals.title: Mysterious elephant deaths in Kenya raise questions around pesticides
signals.summary: A wave of Kenyan elephant deaths has been blamed on pesticides, but experts tell the BBC they are doubtful.

signals.title: EU Ministers Set to Meet Over Migrant Crossings in Ceuta
signals.summary: [RFI] The European Union will hold an emergency video conference meeting of national ministers on Tuesday to discuss the mass migrant crossings into Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta.

signals.title: Senegal's Diomaye Faye On a Visit to Mali, His First As Ecowas' President
signals.summary: [RFI] Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye is in Bamako this Tuesday for a one-day working visit. He is travelling there in a dual capacity, as Head of State of Senegal and current Chair of ECOWAS. He is scheduled to hold talks with his Malian counterpart, Assimi Goïta, just days after launching his own political party in Dakar.

signals.title: Ebola misinformation fuels violent attacks on health workers
signals.summary: BBC Verify looks at multiple incidents linked to misinformation during latest Ebola outbreak, which has infected more than 1,700 people and killed 580 in DR Congo since mid-May.

signals.title: Mali: le président de la Transition accorde une grâce à un agent français de la DGSE
signals.summary: Au Mali, le président de la Transition Assimi Goïta a gracié un agent de renseignement français sous statut diplomatique, condamné au Mali à 20 ans de prison en juin, a annoncé jeudi le gouvernement malien dans un communiqué publié sur Facebook. Ce geste de clémence et d'apaisement intervient après des années de fortes tensions entre Paris et Bamako.

signals.title: Maroc : les promoteurs immobiliers en plein âge d’or ?
signals.summary: Addoha, Alliances, Résidences Dar Saada : l’immobilier marocain renoue avec la croissance. Portés par la Coupe du monde 2030 et l’aide directe au logement, les grands promoteurs du royaume affichent des bilans assainis et des carnets de commandes bien garnis.

signals.title: CAN féminine : le Cameroun rejoint le Malawi en finale
signals.summary: Le Cameroun et le Malawi s'affronteront en finale de la Coupe d'Afrique des nations féminine dimanche à Rabat et tenteront chacun de décrocher leur premier titre de championnes d'Afrique.

signals.title: Fewer children, more seniors as fertility drops across Maghreb
signals.summary: Economic pressures and changing social norms are driving couples in Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia to have fewer babies, with a recent study saying Maghreb fertility was at a historic low. Across all three Maghreb countries, fertility rates fell by more than half since the 1970s.

signals.title: DRC: World Health Organisation Chief sounds alarm on ebola outbreak
signals.summary: Having returned from a trip to the Democratic Republic of Congo, the world health organisaiton chief is sounding the alarm on the ebola outbreak.

signals.title: Soudan: les paramilitaires reprennent une ville dans le Nil bleu à la frontière avec l’Éthiopie
signals.summary: Les paramilitaires des Forces de soutien rapide ont annoncé ce mercredi 12 août avoir pris le contrôle de la ville de Geissan, dans l’État du Nil bleu au sud-est du Soudan, à la frontière avec l’Éthiopie. L’attaque des FSR a été précédée par des frappes de drones et des tirs à l’artillerie lourde mardi. Les forces sont venues depuis l’Éthiopie. L’armée soudanaise occupe actuellement d’autres localités au Nil bleu et cela depuis juin dernier. Après le revers essuyé au…

signals.title: Chawinga sisters fire Malawi into Wafcon final
signals.summary: Malawi's fairy tale run at the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations goes on as sisters Tabitha and Temwa Chawinga share three goals in a 3-1 semi-final win over Algeria.

signals.title: RDC : l’épidémie d’Ebola pourrait dépasser le bilan record de 2014-2016
signals.summary: L’épidémie d’Ebola qui sévit en République démocratique du Congo (RDC) est déjà la deuxième plus importante jamais enregistrée et progresse à un rythme inédit, selon l’Organisation mondiale de la santé (OMS), avec 4 449 cas confirmés et 2 061 décès.

signals.title: RDC : à Bunia, Ebola frappe aussi l’économie locale
signals.summary: À Bunia, l’épidémie d’Ebola ne frappe pas seulement le système de santé. Elle paralyse aussi l’économie locale. Au marché, les vendeurs voient leurs clients se raréfier et leurs marchandises rester invendues. Pour certains, chaque journée qui passe fragilise un peu plus leur activité.

signals.title: Algérie, Malawi, Maroc, Cameroun : la course à la finale de la CAN féminine est lancée
signals.summary: Les demi-finales de la Coupe d’Afrique des nations féminine se disputent ce mercredi 12 août à Rabat. L’Algérie affronte le Malawi à 18 heures, avant le choc entre le Maroc, pays hôte, et le Cameroun à 21 heures.

signals.title: Morocco's Royal Armed Forces Deploy Extensive Aerial Fleet in National Forest Fire Response
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- Morocco's Royal Armed Forces (FAR) lead the aerial forest fire response by deploying their full range of firefighting assets. The force deploys a fleet of eight Canadair CL-415 aircraft operated by the Royal Air Force, as well as 15 Turbo Thrush aircraft and two EC225 Super Puma firefighting helicopters operated by the Royal Gendarmerie.

signals.title: DR Congo Ebola death toll surpasses 2,000 as scientists trace likely origin
signals.summary: Adding to scientists' understanding of the crisis, a new study has found that the outbreak was most likely triggered by a new spillover of the virus from animals to humans, rather than continued transmission from a previous Ebola outbreak.

signals.title: Ebola en RDC : l’OMS appelle à un essai clinique du vaccin Ervebo
signals.summary: En République démocratique du Congo, l’épidémie d’Ebola progresse à une vitesse inédite et dépasse désormais les 4 000 cas déclarés. Face au variant Bundibugyo, l’OMS appelle à un essai clinique du vaccin Ervebo, seul vaccin disponible contre Ebola.

signals.title: Govt Orders Bus Drivers to Switch After Long Journeys to Curb Fatigue
signals.summary: [Nile Post] The government has introduced new measures requiring bus operators to change drivers after long-distance journeys, as authorities intensify efforts to curb driver fatigue following a series of fatal road crashes in recent weeks.

signals.title: Bus Rollover in Cabo Ledo Leaves 30 Injured
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- At least 30 people were injured this Sunday morning when a Real Express bus overturned in Cabo Ledo, Angola's northern province of Icolo e Bengo.

signals.title: Nigeria's mass wedding - and how telling lovers from fraudsters is proving tricky
signals.summary: The scheme is for couples who cannot afford the significant financial costs associated with marriage.

signals.title: New Senegal Government Bond (Bat Sen 2026-2027) Listed On Daba Finance With 7.25 Percent Coupon Rate
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Daba Finance is proud to announce the listing of the new Senegal Government Bond (BAT SEN 2026-2027, ISIN: SN0000005182), offering African investors a compelling opportunity to diversify their portfolios with a secure fixed-income instrument. This bond, issued by the Government of Senegal, carries an attractive annual coupon rate of 7.25% and a yield to maturity of 7.25%.

signals.title: Le Clos' home destroyed by fire after he sets Commonwealths record
signals.summary: Chad le Clos reveals his apartment in South Africa was destroyed by a fatal fire in a "heartbreaking tragedy" - the night after he became the most decorated athlete in Commonwealth Games history.

signals.title: How the Ceuta Border Crossing Incident Immediately Played Into the Hands of Spain's Far Right
signals.summary: [The Conversation Africa] It is estimated that more than 50,000 migrants crossed entered the small Spanish enclave of Ceuta in the course of a single day after the border effectively collapsed. Ceuta, an autonomous city, sits on Morocco's northern coast. The Spanish government has said almost all of the migrants have since returned to Morocco, and at least 57 have died.

signals.title: Russia's 'Africa Corps' Airstrikes Kill Civilians
signals.summary: [HRW] Nairobi -- Apparent Indiscriminate Attack in Village Held by Islamist Armed Group

signals.title: Cameroun : comment la Sosucam a changé de mains
signals.summary: Alors que Somdia, filiale du groupe Castel, avait annoncé son retrait de la première sucrerie du Cameroun, un consortium local, comptant l’avocat Joseph Pagop Noupoué mais aussi Henriette Noutchougouin et William Nkontchou, reprend le flambeau.

signals.title: Mali : l’armée annonce la libération de 82 soldats et Goïta gracie un Français
signals.summary: L’armée malienne a annoncé jeudi la libération de 82 de ses soldats, retenus en otages depuis avril par des groupes armés affiliés à Al-Qaïda et au Front de libération de l’Azawad (FLA). Le chef de la junte, Assimi Goïta, a gracié un agent français condamné à 20 ans de prison.

signals.title: Ebola en RDC: derrière les millions annoncés pour la riposte, le défi de coordonner les financements
signals.summary: En République démocratique du Congo (RDC), le coût prévu de la riposte à Ebola change fortement d’échelle. Prévu pour une durée de trois mois, le premier plan national avait été budgété à 240 millions de dollars. Non finalisé encore, le nouveau plan présenté par le gouvernement qui doit financer non seulement la lutte contre le virus, mais aussi la continuité des services essentiels de santé, atteint, lui, désormais, 940 millions de dollars, selon Anne Ancia,…

signals.summary:

signals.summary: Several players, including Duan Jansen, have earned their maiden Proteas call-up for a white-ball tour of Namibia. The tour serves as a prelude to a busy home summer as well as an opportunity to strengthen cricket in Africa.

signals.title: Centrafrique : l’ambassadeur de France visé par une procédure disciplinaire
signals.summary: La France a engagé une procédure disciplinaire contre son ambassadeur en République centrafricaine, Bruno Foucher, après une enquête administrative portant sur de possibles manquements aux règles de sécurité à la résidence diplomatique de Bangui.

signals.title: Abductors of Anambra Billionaire Businessman, Jezco, Demand N1.5bn Ransom
signals.summary: [Vanguard] The abductors of the Chairman of Jezco Group, Chief Sir Joseph Ezeokafor, have reportedly increased their ransom demand to N1.5 billion, according to a report by Arise TV.

signals.title: Nigeria Take On South Africa in World Cup Playoff Today - Time and Where to Watch
signals.summary: [Vanguard] African women's football giants South Africa and Nigeria clash on Thursday in Casablanca under high-pressure circumstances neither team envisioned.

signals.title: Car &amp; General Net Profit Up Four-Fold to Sh2.6bn
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Car & General (C&G) profit after tax grew more than four-fold to Sh2.6 billion in the half year ending June 30, 2026, boosted by increased sales.

signals.title: Trade CS Kinyanjui Says Agoa Extension Eases Trade Uncertainty
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The proposed extension of the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) to December 2028 will give Kenyan manufacturers greater certainty to plan production, Investment, Trade and Industry Cabinet Secretary Lee Kinyanjui has said.

signals.title: Soudan : les FSR revendiquent la prise de Geissan, ville frontalière de l'Éthiopie
signals.summary: Au Soudan, les paramilitaires des Forces de Soutien Rapide ont annoncé avoir capturé la ville de Geissan, dans l'État du Nil Bleu, à la frontière avec l'Éthiopie.

signals.title: Crise migratoire à Ceuta : le Maroc assure prendre « toutes les mesures nécessaires »
signals.summary: Les autorités marocaines ont annoncé, ce mercredi 12 août, mobiliser leurs forces pour tenter de contrer tout nouvel afflux de migrants vers l’enclave espagnole, après avoir constaté une nouvelle vague de désinformation sur les réseaux sociaux.

signals.title: Hugo Obi, pionnier du jeu vidéo mobile made in Africa (2/3)
signals.summary: Innovation africaine (2/3). Fan de jeux vidéo durant son adolescence, ce Nigérian de 44 ans s'est lancé en 2012 dans le secteur avec l'idée d'ouvrir le genre aux univers africains. Pionnière sur le continent, son entreprise Maliyo Games est parvenue à imposer son style et ambitionne désormais de s'étendre au-delà de ses frontières.

signals.title: Can Tanzania Become an Upper-Middle Income Country?
signals.summary: [Independent (Kampala)] Tanzania has set its sights on becoming a $1 trillion, upper-middle-income economy by mid-century. Under a long-term plan known as Vision 2050, the country is seeking to grow the size of its economy tenfold from current levels and to increase GDP per capita to $7,000 from $1,318.

signals.title: Ruto Seeks National Consensus On Kenya's Development Beyond 2030
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- President William Ruto is this morning expected to launch a nationwide conversation aimed at shaping Kenya's long-term development agenda beyond Vision 2030.

signals.title: RDC: la coalition d'opposition C64 maintient son ultimatum pour la convocation d'un dialogue national inclusif

signals.title: Vultures are disappearing in Nigeria - but the 'Vulture King' is fighting to reverse the trend
signals.summary: Some see them as sinister or hunt them for ritual use but these birds play a vital role in nature's cycle.

signals.title: CAN féminine 2026: le Cameroun s'offre la finale face au Maroc, pays hôte
signals.summary: Après deux échecs consécutifs en finale, le Maroc a été éliminé dès les demi-finales par le Cameroun lors de la séance de tirs au but  (0-0, 3 tab à 1). Les Camerounaises affronteront le Malawi, tombeur de l'Algérie (3-1) quelques heures plus tôt, dimanche 16 août pour le titre.

signals.title: Justice for Susan Magara Must Not Become Collective Blame Against Muslims
signals.summary: [Nile Post] The judgment delivered by the High Court of Uganda on August 3, 2026, in Uganda v Lubega Yusuf & Eight Others, Criminal Session Case No. 0810 of 2020, has understandably revived public discussion about the brutal kidnapping and murder of Susan Magara.

signals.title: Entebbe Hospital Staffing At 21 Percent As MPs Warn of Growing Pressure On Health Services
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Entebbe Regional Referral Hospital is operating with just 21.8% of its approved staffing structure, raising concerns about the pressure on health workers and the quality of care at a facility serving a growing population.

signals.title: Karamoja Needs More Than Food Relief - It Needs Climate Justice
signals.summary: [Nile Post] For decades, Karamoja has made national headlines for drought, hunger and humanitarian crises. Yet history may ultimately judge it not as Uganda's hungriest sub-region, but as one of its greatest missed opportunities.

signals.title: Local Governments Need Stronger Watchdogs, Not Just Surprise Inspections
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Since taking charge of the Ministry of Local Government, Honourable Balaam Barugahara and his deputy, Honourable Justine Nameere, have demonstrated a strong commitment to improving accountability in local governments. One of the approaches they have adopted is making impromptu visits to local governments to identify and expose cases of corruption and mismanagement, with several district officials subsequently interdicted or handed over to police for further…

signals.title: Mpigi Drinkers Find Balaam's 3pm Bar Directive Too Bitter to Take
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Drinkers in Mpigi District have mocked the Minister of Local Government, Balaam Barugahara Ateenyi, over a directive restricting bars from opening before 3pm.

signals.title: Kikuube Youth Embrace Tree Planting for Climate Resilience and Livelihoods
signals.summary: [Nile Post] As Uganda joins the rest of the world to mark International Youth Day, young people in Kikuube District are increasingly turning to tree planting and sustainable forestry as a pathway to environmental conservation, climate resilience and long-term livelihoods.

signals.title: Doctors Give Government 14 Days to Resolve Medical Intern Crisis
signals.summary: [Nile Post] The Uganda Medical Association (UMA) has given government 14 days to resolve the standoff over the deployment and welfare of medical interns, warning that doctors will otherwise begin nationwide industrial action.

signals.title: Intern Doctors Threaten Boycott Over Scrapped Allowances Under New Health Ministry Policy
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Medical intern doctors in Uganda have threatened to boycott deployment to health facilities following the Ministry of Health's decision to scrap their monthly allowances under a new internship policy.

signals.title: Cattle Restocking Scheme Faces Scrutiny Over Alleged Abuse in Acholi
signals.summary: [Nile Post] The government's cattle restocking programme in Acholi, Lango and Teso regions is facing scrutiny after Parliament uncovered alleged favouritism, bribery and manipulation of beneficiary lists in Gulu.

signals.title: Government Mobilises Local Leaders for Nationwide Cleaning Exercise
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Prime Minister Robinah Nabbanja has urged local government leaders, including elected LC chairpersons, to immediately mobilise communities for the government's nationwide cleaning exercise scheduled for August 29.

signals.title: Les actrices des luttes anticoloniales: Andrée Blouin, influente conseillère et mobilisatrice de réseaux féminins [4/10]
signals.summary: La suite de notre série sur les actrices oubliées de la décolonisation. Nous nous penchons aujourd'hui sur le parcours d'Andrée Blouin, enfant métisse née en Centrafrique, qui a fait ses premiers pas en politique en Guinée et est devenue une influente conseillère de Patrice Lumumba au moment de l'indépendance du Congo. Le récit de Laurent Correau.

signals.title: A Traveller's Guide to Discovering Morocco With Flexible Car Rental
signals.summary: [Ghanaian Times] Morocco offers a landscape of contrasts, where ancient cities, scenic coasts, and majestic mountains create a tapestry of unforgettable experiences. Travelers seeking freedom and convenience can rent a car Morocco cheap, allowing them to explore the country at their own pace without compromising on reliability or comfort. From vibrant markets to tranquil coastal routes, each journey becomes a seamless blend of adventure, style, and accessibility.…

signals.title: Portraits des diasporas africaines: Christian-Brice Ondo, un éditeur gabonais dans la cour des grands [4/5]
signals.summary: Chirurgienne, patineuse, éditeur, pâtissier, leurs parcours singuliers racontent la France d’aujourd’hui, riche de ses talents et de ses diversités. Né(e)s ici ou venus d’ailleurs, ces femmes et ces hommes inspirent par leur engagement et leur réussite. Leurs portraits sont autant de modèles pour les générations futures. Dans ce quatrième épisode, le Gabonais Christian-Brice Ondo nous raconte comment à 51 ans il mène une carrière d'éditeur. Depuis 2021, il dirige sa…

signals.title: De Tunis à Dakar, la tête dans les nuages pour observer l'éclipse solaire
signals.summary: Des millions de personnes ont levé les yeux ce mercredi pour assister à une éclipse solaire, spectaculaire par endroits en Europe mais également visible en Afrique. C'est à Tabarka où le phénomène a été le plus marqué en Tunisie, avec 59,06 % du soleil masqué. L’éclipse partielle a aussi pu être observée depuis Dakar et plusieurs régions du Sénégal, avec un maximum d’occultation d’environ 37 % du disque solaire en fin de journée.

signals.title: CAN féminine 2026: le Malawi élimine l’Algérie et file en finale
signals.summary: Mercredi 12 août, l’Algérie et le Malawi s'affrontaient au stade olympique de Rabat, en demi-finale de la CAN 2026 féminine. Jamais les deux pays ne s’étaient encore hissées à ce stade de la compétition. Les Malawites se sont imposées 3-1.

signals.title: Mali-Algérie : entre Assimi Goïta et Abdelmadjid Tebboune, les dessous d’une réconciliation inattendue
signals.summary: Après plus d’une année de tensions qui avaient abouti à une rupture diplomatique sans précédent, Bamako et Alger renouent le dialogue. Une normalisation fruit de plusieurs médiations, menées par la Russie, par le Niger et par le Congo.

signals.title: Sidi Bou Saïd, un joyau tunisien, inscrit au patrimoine mondial de l’Unesco
signals.summary: Le village côtier de Sidi Bou Saïd, célèbre pour son architecture blanche et bleue et son histoire spirituelle, continue de célébrer son inscription récente sur la Liste du patrimoine mondial de l’Unesco.

signals.title: SA’s maths teacher shortage: The numbers, and what could actually fix it
signals.summary: The South African teaching fraternity faces numerous challenges, including shortages, an ageing cohort and burnout, but there are still ways to fix the problem.

signals.title: De Brazzaville à Libreville, Omar Denis Bongo Ondimba à pas prudents vers la politique
signals.summary: Omar Denis Bongo Ondimba séjourne de plus en plus régulièrement à Libreville. Le petit-fils de Denis Sassou Nguesso et frère d’Ali Bongo Ondimba reste discret, mais entretient un flou stratégique autour d’un retour au Gabon et d’ambitions politiques.

signals.title: Maroc : Azrou, un collège au service d’une « politique berbère »
signals.summary: Conçu sous le Protectorat pour produire des cadres et auxiliaires acquis à la France, le collège berbère d’Azrou est devenu, malgré lui, un vecteur de mobilité sociale. Histoire d’une institution trahie par ses propres élèves, qui l’ont utilisée pour écrire leur histoire nationale.

signals.title: Michaely Bihina: «Tem sido uma experiência muito boa com os Camarões»
signals.summary: O Campeonato Africano das Nações, que decorre em território marroquino, já está nas meias-finais com os seguintes encontros: Argélia-Malawi e Marrocos-Camarões.

signals.title: Pétrole : pourquoi le Nigeria se tourne de plus en plus vers la mer
signals.summary: Pour échapper aux défaillances techniques de ses oléoducs terrestres et aux actes de sabotage qui les frappent dans le delta du Niger, la Nigerian National Petroleum Company privilégie les exportations de brut par voie maritime.

signals.title: Gachagua Accuses Ruto of Humiliating Kindiki As Kenya Kwanza-ODM Alliance Takes Shape
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Former Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua has accused President William Ruto of deliberately humiliating his successor, Deputy President Kithure Kindiki, amid growing political ties between the ruling Kenya Kwanza coalition and the Orange Democratic Movement (ODM) ahead of the 2027 General Election.

signals.title: KFS Turns to Space Technology to Track Kenya's Forests and Boost Tree-Growing Drive
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The Kenya Forest Service (KFS) is turning to satellite technology and Earth observation data to strengthen monitoring of the country's forests as Kenya accelerates efforts to expand national tree cover.

signals.title: Freestyle fundamentals with Nigeria's national champion
signals.summary: Meet Evelyn Okafor – a four-time Nigerian champion, three-time African champion, and the first African woman to qualify for the World Freestyle Football Championship.

signals.title: Rwanda : Nyakabingo, mine de tungstène stratégique pour la défense américaine.
signals.summary: 🇷🇼 Au Rwanda, la mine de Nyakabingo est devenue en quelques mois l’un des principaux fournisseurs de tungstène des États-Unis. Ce métal stratégique, indispensable à l’industrie de défense, pourrait prendre une importance croissante alors que Washington prévoit de bannir les approvisionnements chinois destinés à ses usages militaires.

signals.title: Zambie : Brian Mundubile dénonce une campagne déséquilibrée à la veille de la présidentielle
signals.summary: À la veille de l’élection présidentielle zambienne, le principal challenger du président sortant Hakainde Hichilema, Brian Mundubile, dénonce des restrictions qui, selon lui, ont entravé sa campagne et rompu l’équilibre entre les candidats.

signals.title: SA, China Deepen Cooperation On Disability Inclusion
signals.summary: [SAnews.gov.za] South Africa and China are set to deepen cooperation on disability inclusion, data, universal design, artificial intelligence and assistive technology as the two countries seek practical ways to improve the lives and rights of persons with disabilities.

signals.title: Plan Afloat to Introduce Kabbadi in School, Youth Groups After Latest Success At African Championships
signals.summary: [Capital FM] NAIROBI, Kenya, August 12, 2026 - Kenya Kabbadi Union (KKU) founding president Silas Jakakimba says they will intensify efforts to grow the sport around the country following the country's triumph at the African Kabbadi Championships in Zanzibar.

signals.title: Over 400 Minors Kidnapped By Armed Groups in 2024
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- Over 400 minors were recruited by armed groups in the northern Mozambican province of Cabo Delgado in 2024, according to a report carried out by the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Health Cluster.

signals.title: 'Rude' Magistrate's Impeachment Set Aside
signals.summary: [GroundUp] Magistrate's Commission must reconsider sanction, high court rules

signals.title: RDC : autour de Tshisekedi, d’ultimes tractations en attendant la convocation du dialogue
signals.summary: Alors que plusieurs sources évoquent une possible prise de parole du président Félix Tshisekedi dans les prochains jours, ce dernier a réuni des représentants des Églises et les membres d’une commission spéciale pour évoquer les contours des futures assises.

signals.title: RDC: derrière la défiance face à Ebola, ce que les communautés disent de la riposte sanitaire
signals.summary: En République démocratique du Congo (RDC), alors qu'une grande partie des nouvelles contaminations échappe encore aux chaînes de transmission connues, les autorités congolaises veulent placer davantage les communautés au centre de la lutte contre Ebola. Un bulletin consacré aux tendances infodémiques montre aussi que les remontées du terrain ne portent pas seulement sur les rumeurs et le déni.

signals.title: Zambian elections: Will Edgar Lungu’s ghost come back to haunt the poll?
signals.summary: The rising cost of living, governance issues and the economy all feature when Zambians mark their ballots in the 13 August national elections – but the ghost of the late former president Edgar Lungu will be haunting the vote in this staunchly religious country.

signals.title: Man Jailed Seven Years for Forging Nema Environmental Certificates
signals.summary: [Nile Post] The Makindye Standards, Utilities and Wildlife Court has sentenced a man to seven years in prison for forging National Environment Management Authority (NEMA) environmental approval certificates.

signals.title: Kyotera Police Recover 10 Suspected Stolen Cows, Businessman Arrested
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Police in Kyotera District have recovered 10 cows suspected to have been stolen from different areas as security agencies intensify operations against the rising theft of livestock in parts of Uganda.

signals.title: I'm Here to Fix Issues At Foreign Affairs, Ayebare Says
signals.summary: [Nile Post] Members of the press arrived at the Wapakabulo Auditorium at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs headquarters by 8.30am for Ambassador Adonia Ayebare's first briefing as Foreign Affairs Minister, only for the new minister to walk in more than two hours later, at 10.55am.

signals.title: Kenya: Mandatory battery storage for solar, wind projects sparks early tariff pushback
signals.summary: Kenya Power is moving to put the brakes on new wind and solar projects, requiring developers to add battery storage as the grid struggles to absorb more intermittent power. The shift comes as the utility seeks cheaper electricity while balancing the higher costs of keeping renewable energy reliable.

signals.title: Hichilema rallies thousands as Zambia heads to presidential vote
signals.summary: Tens of thousands of supporters gathered in Lusaka for President Hakainde Hichilema’s final campaign rally ahead of Thursday’s election, as the incumbent seeks a second term amid concerns over jobs, living costs and allegations of opposition intimidation.

signals.title: Jaramogi Oginga Odinga Mausoleum Closed for Three Months for Renovation
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The Jaramogi Oginga Odinga Mausoleum in Bondo, Siaya County, has been temporarily closed to the public to allow construction and renovation works at the historic site.

signals.title: Mali - Evidence of War Crimes By Armed Groups in Gao Region
signals.summary: [AI London] Summary killings of at least 19 Malian soldiers by members of armed groups in Tabrichat, a village in the Gao region, in northern Mali, must be investigated as war crimes, Amnesty International said after analyzing video footage of the incident which took place after the soldiers were ambushed on 18 July.

signals.title: EU - European Leaders Must Respond With Humanity and Solidarity to the Situation in Ceuta

signals.title: Petition Challenging Kenya Railways CEO Phillip Mainga's Tenure Withdrawn
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- A legal challenge over the continued tenure of Kenya Railways Corporation Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer Phillip Mainga has been withdrawn, barely a day after the Employment and Labour Relations Court in Kisumu issued interim orders stopping him from exercising the powers of the office.

signals.title: Farmers Urged to Cut Use of Hazardous Pesticides
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The Harm Reduction Society of Kenya has called on the government to lower the cost of pesticides used by farmers and strengthen regulations to discourage the use of highly hazardous products.

signals.title: Government Gets Tougher On Illegal Mining
signals.summary: [Scrolla] · The proposed General Mining Laws Amendment Bill would change several laws and introduce a specific offence aimed at cracking down on illegal mining.

signals.title: HELB to Be Scrapped Under New Bill, Replaced By Funding Authority
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The Higher Education Loans Board (HELB), Universities Fund Board and TVET Funding Board will be replaced by the Tertiary Education Funding Authority if a new Bill sponsored by Majority Leader Kimani Ichung'wah is passed into law.

signals.title: Zohran vs Geordin — Two sons of Cape Town, two very different mayors
signals.summary: In the New York City corner, we have Zohran Mamdani, and in Cape Town’s corner, we have Geordin Hill-Lewis. We judge how the two youthful mayors compare in terms of new housing, use of city land, rent stabilisation and transportation.

signals.title: Nigeria says its crude is available. Why is Dangote still looking abroad?
signals.summary: The upstream regulator says pricing and weak supply contracts – rather than a shortage of Nigerian oil – explain why domestic refineries received less than half their allocated crude in early 2026.

signals.title: Luweero NRM Leaders Raise Concerns Over Alleged Vote Buying in Local Elections
signals.summary: [Nile Post] NRM leaders in Luweero District have raised concerns over alleged vote buying and irregularities in the recent LC1 and LC2 elections, claiming that land brokers may have injected money into the contests to influence the election of local leaders.

signals.title: When Rural Women Gain Power, Families and Communities Grow Stronger
signals.summary: [Daily News] Dodoma -- Talk of agriculture in many rural communities, a seed is more than something planted in the soil. It can represent food, income, family health and the future of farming. For women, however, access to resources and opportunities has often been shaped by social and economic barriers that limit their participation in decisions affecting their families and communities.

signals.title: Government Collects 183.3 Million Meticais in Revenue
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- The Mozambican government has collected, during the first half of 2026, 183.3 million meticais (2.9 million US dollars at the current exchange rate) in revenue, which corresponds to 45 percent of target set in the Economic and Social Plan.

signals.title: Zambie : dernière ligne droite avant la présidentielle pour Hichilema
signals.summary: Des dizaines de milliers de partisans du président zambien Hakainde Hichilema se sont rassemblés mardi à Lusaka, à deux jours des élections présidentielle et législatives.

signals.title: Diplomatic Tension Erupts As SA Tells Malawi to Reimburse Deportation Costs
signals.summary: [Nyasa Times] South Africa has sparked a diplomatic storm after formally demanding that Malawi, Nigeria and Ethiopia reimburse part of the R292 million (about K29 billion) it has spent this year deporting undocumented migrants -- with Malawians making up the largest share of those removed.

signals.title: Govt to Review Over 1,000 Laws to Attract Tech
signals.summary: [Daily News] Dar es Salaam -- THE government plans to review more than 1,000 laws to create a regulatory framework capable of supporting artificial intelligence, digital commerce and technologydriven investment as it seeks to make Tanzania's economy more competitive.

signals.title: Ruto - Next Election Will Come and Go, Kenya Must Think Beyond 2027
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- President William Ruto has told Kenyans to look beyond the 2027 General Election and focus on developing a long-term national plan that puts the interests of future generations ahead of political cycles.

signals.title: Côte d’Ivoire :  Yacine Idriss Diallo unique candidat à la FIF, les clubs brandissent le boycott
signals.summary: La Fédération ivoirienne de football élira son président le 12 septembre, Yacine Idriss Diallo étant l’unique candidat, après des tractations gouvernementales. Mais la grogne couve chez les clubs, qui réclament plus de moyens.

signals.title: Uíge - the Violence of the Angolan Political Police
signals.summary: [Maka] Neide dos Santos, 24, was sitting in a bus parked near UNITA's provincial headquarters in Uíge at about 2pm when stones began striking the vehicle. Another activist and the driver were with her.

signals.title: Cameroun : de Genève à Yaoundé, Samuel Mvondo Ayolo, gardien du temple Biya
signals.summary: Il est le directeur du cabinet civil de Paul Biya et, entre la Suisse, la France et le Cameroun, son bouclier pour contrer rumeurs et rivalités au sein du sérail. Portrait de Samuel Mvondo Ayolo, homme de l’ombre d’un président absent.

signals.title: Nigeria and Mozambique Show How Health Systems Can Withstand Funding Cuts
signals.summary: [allAfrica] For decades, many health programmes across sub-Saharan Africa have relied on a familiar model: donors fund disease-specific projects, parallel delivery structures are built around them, and services expand or contract with the funding cycle.

signals.title: FIC Luanda 2026 Opens Registration for Lualab
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- The Luanda International Film Festival (FIC Luanda) 2026 officially opened registrations on Monday in the country's capital for its film writing and development workshop (LUALab), aimed at selecting Angolan fiction films.

signals.title: Angop Strengthens Journalists' Technical Skills
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- Seventy-six journalists from Angola News Agency (ANGOP) on Monday began a month-long refresher seminar in Luanda on editorial standards, journalistic techniques and the Portuguese language.

signals.title: Nationl Police Arrests Two Fake Criminal Investigation Services Agents in Luvo
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Mbanza Kongo -- Two individuals posing as agents of the Criminal Investigation Service (SIC) in the municipality of Luvo, Zaire province, were arrested on Saturday by the National Police.

signals.title: Norwegian Diplomat Praises Excellent Relations With Angola
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- Outgoing Norwegian Ambassador to Angola Bjørnar Dahl Hotvedt on Monday described relations between the two countries as excellent, particularly in the oil sector, technology transfer and job creation.

signals.title: President João Lourenço Changes Composition of Inacom Board of Directors
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- President João Lourenço on Monday changed the composition of the Board of Directors of the Angolan Communications Institute (INACOM), dismissing two directors and appointing two new members.

signals.title: HM the King Receives Greetings From Mauritius President On Throne Day
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- His Majesty King Mohammed VI received a message of congratulations from the President of the Republic of Mauritius, Dharambeer Gokhool, on the occasion of the 27th anniversary of the Sovereign's accession to the Throne of His Glorious Ancestors.

signals.title: Ethiopian President Congratulates HM the King On Throne Day
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- His Majesty King Mohammed VI received a message of congratulations from the President of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, Taye Atske Selassie, on the occasion of the 27th anniversary of the Sovereign's accession to the Throne of His Glorious Ancestors.

signals.title: HM the King Receives Congratulatory Message From Togolese President On Throne Day
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- His Majesty King Mohammed VI received a message of congratulations from the President of the Council of the Togolese Republic, Faure Essozimna Gnassingbé, on the occasion of the 27th anniversary of the Sovereign's accession to the Throne of His Glorious Ancestors.

signals.title: Dakhla's White Dune That Captivated Christopher Nolan - Inside 'The Odyssey's Moroccan Shoot
signals.summary: [MAP] Rabat -- Renowned Moroccan executive producer Zakaria Alaoui has offered a rare behind-the-scenes account of Christopher Nolan's latest epic, The Odyssey, shot across several regions of the Kingdom. He revealed how the acclaimed filmmaker fell under the spell of Dakhla's White Dune, in southern Morocco.

signals.title: Morocco-Colombia Ties Poised to Regain Full Vitality, Strategic Significance - Ambassador
signals.summary: [MAP] Bogota -- Relations between Morocco and Colombia, built on nearly half a century of friendship, are poised to regain their full vitality and strategic significance, Morocco's Ambassador to Colombia, Farida Loudaya, said.

signals.title: Amman Ministerial Meeting On Supporting Al-Quds, Its Holy Sites Highlights Importance of Role of Al-Quds Committee Chaired By HM the King
signals.summary: [MAP] Amman -- The ministerial meeting on supporting Al-Quds and its holy sites, held on Wednesday in Amman in the presence of ministers from several Arab and Islamic countries, emphasized the importance of the role played by the Al-Quds Committee, chaired by His Majesty King Mohammed VI, and the Bayt Mal Al-Quds Asharif Agency, the executive arm of the Al-Quds Committee.

signals.title: SA’s vanished R1.377-trillion — the cost of compliance without delivery
signals.summary: Every year, billions of rands intended for clinics, roads and clean water vanish into a black hole of administrative compliance that delivers zero actual value to South African citizens.

signals.title: Après une saisie record, le Liberia veut intensifier la lutte anti-drogue
signals.summary: Le président libérien Joseph Boakai a désigné un nouveau directeur de l'Agence libérienne de lutte contre la drogue, affichant sa volonté d'"intensifier" le combat contre le trafic après la plus grande saisie de drogue de l'histoire du pays : près de quatre tonnes de cocaïne estimées à 276 millions d'euros. Depuis ces saisies, les Libériens ont fait part de leur indignation, réclamant des mesures plus strictes de surveillance des responsables et policiers liés à la lutte…

signals.title: Why AI’s spoils will pass South Africa by
signals.summary: Few questions matter more than what the long-term economic and social impacts of AI are, particularly for countries such as South Africa, which are a long way — in every sense — from the AI deus ex machina.

signals.title: RDC : un début de décrispation politique, avant un dialogue national ?
signals.summary: Quelques signaux faibles laissent penser à un moment de détente du pouvoir après que le président, Félix Tshisekedi, s’est dit ouvert à l’organisation d’un dialogue national.

signals.title: Guinée : que signifie le nouvel accord avec le FMI ?
signals.summary: Conakry s’apprête à obtenir 425 millions de dollars dans le cadre d’un accord avec le Fonds monétaire international. Au-delà des financements attendus, le programme doit surtout imposer un cadre de discipline pour gérer la rente minière et renforcer les finances publiques.

signals.title: Angola: UNITA denuncia intimidação no Uíge pelas forças de segurança
signals.summary: Nelito Ekuikui, deputado da UNITA, maior força da oposição angolana, alega que a repressão policial não se limitou ao comício do partido do galo negro no sábado no Uíge. O dirigente da União nacional para a independência total de Angola acusa o governo nesta província do Norte do país de ter usado as forças de defesa e segurança para intimidar os militantes da UNITA, em ano pré eleitoral.

signals.title: Au Congo de Denis Sassou Nguesso, les Russes d’Africa Corps opèrent à visage découvert
signals.summary: Les organes de propagande russes ont récemment rendu publique la formation par les « instructeurs » d’Africa Corps, de la Direction générale de la sécurité présidentielle (DGSP) du Congo-Brazzaville. Le dernier épisode d’une relation assumée. Décryptage.

signals.title: Presbyterian Reverend Urges Churches to Promote Social Peace
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Ondjiva -- The Reverend of the Presbyterian Church in the province of Cunene, António Ngula, urged on Sunday (09) to believers, pastors, and church leaders in the municipality of Ondjiva to look out for love, solidarity, compassion, and support for needy people in order to promote social peace.

signals.title: Ceast Advocates Strengthening of Dialogue Among Institutions
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- The Head of the Bishops' Conference of Angola and São Tomé and Príncipe (CEAST), Dom José Manuel Imbamba, advocated on Monday (10) in Luanda for the strengthening of institutional dialogue and a greater focus on citizenship education.

signals.title: Minister of Culture Acknowledges Cuba's Role in Angola's History
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- The Minister of Culture, Filipe Zau, acknowledged on Monday (10) in Havana, Cuba's role in Angola's social, political, and economic transformations, with an emphasis on the education, health, and human development sectors.

signals.title: Rice Import Traders Accuse Brokers of Hijacking Business
signals.summary: [Independent (Kampala)] Kampala -- Rice importers say brokers are allegedly working with officials in the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Cooperatives to take control of the country's rice import business through a permit allocation system. They claim that the permit allocation system has locked genuine traders out of the market.

signals.title: Niger, Mali, Burkina Faso : 5 questions pour comprendre le rôle de la Libye dans la guerre au Sahel
signals.summary: La libération du chef rebelle nigérien Mahmoud Salah par Benghazi marque une rupture nette entre le clan Haftar et la junte de Niamey. Elle illustre comment le Sahel devient le théâtre d’une guerre d’influence libyenne par groupes armés interposés.
